parameters.content:
## 14 Source Attribution

Stitches UTM and referrer data into first-touch and last-touch attribution on every lead.

**Safety rails:** Does not call the rails. It writes attribution fields to your own CRM and database and never contacts a lead.

**Before you enable this:** replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value, point CRM_BASE_URL/CRM_ADAPTER at your CRM, and run it once manually with test data.

Docs: README.md, docs/SETUP.md, docs/COMPLIANCE.md

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO attribution_touches (lead_email, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign,
                                 utm_content, referrer, channel, landing_page, occurred_at)
VALUES (nullif('{{ $json.touch.email }}', ''), '{{ $json.touch.utm_source }}',
        '{{ $json.touch.utm_medium }}', '{{ $json.touch.utm_campaign }}',
        '{{ $json.touch.utm_content }}', '{{ $json.touch.referrer }}',
        '{{ $json.touch.channel }}', '{{ $json.touch.landing_page }}',
        '{{ $json.touch.occurred_at }}'::timestamptz);

=SELECT utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, channel, landing_page, occurred_at
FROM attribution_touches
WHERE lead_email = lower(nullif('{{ $('Parse UTM').item.json.touch.email }}', ''))
ORDER BY occurred_at ASC
LIMIT 200;

=UPDATE leads SET first_touch = '{{ $json.attribution.first_touch }}',
       last_touch = '{{ $json.attribution.last_touch }}',
       touch_count = {{ $json.attribution.touch_count }},
       attribution_path = '{{ $json.attribution.path }}', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE email_key = lower(nullif('{{ $json.lead.email }}', ''));
